payload.title: Navigating the perils of a model grid
payload.description: This notebook addresses the challenges of working with model grids in climate data analysis. It highlights the differences between intuitive latitude-longitude coordinates and the reality of model grids. The notebook demonstrates how to handle and visualize data on these grids using various plotting techniques. It also explores specific datasets from CMIP6 and C-iTRACE, showcasing methods to convert and plot data effectively.
